name: selftest-persona
description: 自测用：经 $DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml 给系统提示词加一个标记，并覆盖一个宿主环境变量，验证 PiLab 侧的变体开关确实生效。

dshHomeFiles.cordis.patch.yml:
# ab-eval self-test variant: a marker in the system prompt.
- id: system-prompt
  config:
    personaPrefix: 'AB-EVAL-VARIANT-MARKER: this session is part of the ab-eval self-test.'
